title: QC AML Investigations
description:
Description
We are seeking an experienced AML Quality Control (QC) / Financial Crime professional with strong expertise in anti-money laundering regulations, financial crime typologies, investigative processes, and case quality review.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience conducting and/or reviewing AML investigations, assessing suspicious activity, identifying investigative gaps, and ensuring cases meet regulatory and internal quality standards. Experience with AML case management platforms such as Actimize, Oracle, SAS, or Verafin is highly preferred.
We are particularly interested in candidates who can discuss their AML QC review experience, challenges encountered, and specific use cases or examples demonstrating their ability to identify issues and improve investigative quality.
Key Qualifications

•
AML Expertise: Strong understanding of AML regulations, financial crime typologies, red flags, and associated risks.

•
AML QC Experience: Hands-on experience performing quality control reviews of AML investigations , including identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

•
Case Management Platforms: Proficiency with at least one AML case management or transaction monitoring platform, such as Actimize, Oracle, SAS, Verafin , or similar tools.

•
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong knowledge of AML compliance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and investigative standards.

•
SAR Experience: Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and/or submitting Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) .

•
Investigative & Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex transactional and behavioral data, identify suspicious patterns, and determine appropriate investigative actions.

•
Risk Assessment: Strong understanding of customer and account risk factors, including sanctions, fraud, terrorist financing, bribery and corruption, and insider threats.

•
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document investigative findings and communicate recommendations.

•
Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct and/or perform QC reviews of end-to-end AML investigations across cases of varying complexity.

• Review investigations involving potential money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and other financial crime risks .

• Assess whether investigative conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence and whether cases meet established regulatory and internal standards.

• Evaluate whether investigators have applied reasonable grounds to suspect (RGS) appropriately when determining whether suspicious activity should be escalated or reported.

• Perform holistic reviews of customer relationships, considering relevant risk factors such as:

• AML risk

• Sanctions exposure

• Fraud

• Bribery and corruption

• Terrorist financing

• Insider threats

• Customer and transactional risk

• Review investigative narratives, supporting documentation, disposition decisions, and SAR recommendations for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.

• Identify investigative gaps, process deficiencies, recurring errors, and quality trends , and provide actionable feedback.

• Utilize AML case management and transaction monitoring platforms to document, manage, review, and resolve cases.

• Draft and/or review SARs in accordance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

• Analyze transactional, customer, and behavioral data to identify suspicious activity and emerging financial crime patterns.

• Partner with investigators, compliance teams, and other stakeholders to improve investigative quality and consistency .

• Support enhancements to AML investigative procedures, quality standards, and controls.

• Ensure all investigations and QC reviews remain aligned with AML policies, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices .

title: Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer
description:
SENIOR ANDROID COMPUTER VISION ENGINEER

Location: Budapest, Hungary

Ways of working: Hybrid
Contract: Permanent, full-time

ABOUT HAWK-EYE INNOVATIONS

Hawk-Eye Innovations is at the forefront of sports technology, delivering officiating, tracking, broadcast and performance solutions across some of the world's biggest sports. As part of Sony Sports, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation, helping athletes, coaches, teams, broadcasters and governing bodies make better decisions through technology.

BRING COMPUTER VISION TO THE WORLD OF SPORT

What if athletes, coaches and teams could access the kind of tracking technology that has traditionally been out of reach?

We’re building a new generation of tracking services for elite and semi-professional sport, putting powerful computer vision technology directly into the hands of the people who need it most.

We’re looking for a Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer to help make that possible.

You’ll join a small, cross-functional engineering team building products at the cutting edge of sport and technology. With the direction set and plenty still to be built, you’ll have the autonomy to shape solutions, make important technical decisions and see your work make a real difference.

THE ROLE

You’ll own computer vision on the device, taking detection and tracking models and making them work reliably on consumer Android phones and tablets.

That means much more than getting a model to run. You’ll optimise and profile inference for real-world hardware, balancing performance with accuracy across different devices, lighting conditions and environments. You’ll work close to the camera capture pipeline, where frame timing, exposure and device behaviour can all affect the quality of the output.

Your challenge is to ensure that the data produced on a mobile device is accurate, reliable and trusted by the wider tracking system.

You’ll work closely with mobile, backend, computer vision and machine learning engineers, with the freedom to own both your technical approach and its implementation. We also embrace AI-augmented and AI-delegated development as part of how we work, enabling a small team to build and iterate at pace.

This is an opportunity to solve genuinely challenging engineering problems, influence how on-device vision is built and help establish the foundations for a technology that can change how sport is experienced and analysed.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Als Head of People Operations baust du das operative HR-Fundament für unsere bald mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitenden im Berliner HQ und unseren deutschlandweiten Portfoliounternehmen.

Wir wachsen monatlich durch Zukäufe von Hausverwaltungen. Damit treffen unterschiedliche Verträge, Datenbestände und Arbeitsweisen aufeinander. Du sorgst dafür, dass daraus verlässliche Personalprozesse entstehen, die mit jeder weiteren Übernahme funktionieren.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Personio, korrekten Mitarbeiterdaten, standardisierten HR-Prozessen und der Bearbeitung konkreter Personal- und Arbeitsrechtsfälle. Du entwirfst die Abläufe, setzt sie selbst um und verantwortest, dass sie im Alltag funktionieren. Bei Kündigungen, Vertragsfragen und Konflikten bist du ein kompetenter Sparringspartner für unsere Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte und bindest bei Bedarf Legal oder externe Rechtsberatung ein.

Führungskräfteentwicklung, Performance Reviews sowie die Gestaltung von Salary Bands und Benefits liegen bei Operations und den verantwortlichen Führungskräften.

DEINE VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Du verantwortest Personio und unsere Mitarbeiterdaten. Personio läuft bereits deutschlandweit. Du entwickelst die Konfiguration, Berechtigungen und Workflows weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Daten vollständig, aktuell und belastbar sind.

- Du integrierst neue Gesellschaften in unsere People Operations. Du prüfst vorhandene Daten und Prozesse, klärst Unstimmigkeiten und überführst neue Portfoliounternehmen in unsere Systeme und Standards.

- Du baust wiederholbare HR-Prozesse und setzt sie um. Von Vertragserstellung und Onboarding über Vertragsänderungen und Beförderungen bis zum Offboarding definierst du klare Zuständigkeiten, Freigaben und Kontrollen.

- Du begleitest konkrete arbeitsrechtliche Fälle. Du klärst Sachverhalte, berätst unsere Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte zu möglichen nächsten Schritten und steuerst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Entscheidern und Rechtsberatern.

- Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Payroll-Daten. Du sorgst dafür, dass relevante Änderungen korrekt und rechtzeitig bei den Verantwortlichen für die Abrechnung ankommen, und klärst Abweichungen.

- Du verbesserst das System hinter dem Einzelfall. Wiederkehrende Probleme übersetzt du in bessere Vorlagen, klare Abläufe und passende Automatisierungen. Mit operativem Reporting machst du Datenlücken, offene Vorgänge und Integrationsfortschritte sichtbar.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- bereits operative HR-Verantwortung für mehrere Hundert Mitarbeitende übernommen hast, idealerweise über mehrere Gesellschaften oder Standorte hinweg.

- HR-Prozesse selbst aufgebaut, eingeführt und anschließend im laufenden Betrieb verantwortet hast.

- Personio oder ein vergleichbares HR-System eigenständig konfiguriert hast und dich mit Datenmigration, Berechtigungen, Workflows und Datenqualität auskennst.

- fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und praktische Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Personalmaßnahmen, insbesondere Kündigungen und Konfliktfällen, mitbringst.

- erkennst, welche Fälle du eigenständig bearbeiten kannst und wann du rechtliche Unterstützung hinzuziehen musst.

- auch bei unvollständigen Informationen klare Prioritäten setzt und Vorgänge zuverlässig bis zum Abschluss steuerst.

- Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitbringst, beispielsweise einem VC-finanzierten Startup, einem PE-finanzierten Unternehmen oder einem Unternehmen mit vielen Zukäufen.

- Deutsch auf C2-Niveau sprichst.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Board certification (required)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Authorization
description:

Our customers - like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy - are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented - and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai
What we are building
Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

•
A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.

•
Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.

•
A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.

•
Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.

•
Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.

•
Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.

•
A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

What your impact will be

•
Set the architectural direction. Design identity and access solutions that meet customer demands for managing user and group access, and are secure, scalable, and built on primitives teams can reuse.

•
Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.

•
Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.

•
Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.

•
Increase velocity and reduce maintenance. Improve our architecture, including removing tech debt, so the team ships faster with less ongoing maintenance.

•
Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.

•
Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What we look for in this role

title: Principal Engineer - Core Cloud Platform
description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the Role: 

The Core Cloud Platform team is responsible for AlphaSense's entire cloud infrastructure, including AWS account management, networking, data storages, and Kubernetes clusters. We build the underlying platform that supports hundreds of services and is used by over 400 globally distributed engineers.

We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.

This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.

It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.

We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.

What You’ll Do:  

• Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform

• Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core

• Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days

• Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell

• Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.

• Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

title: Chief Marketing Officer (Ukrainian-speaking)
description:
CMO (Chief Marketing Officer)
We are an international group of companies operating across European and Latin American markets. We build and scale our own products and projects in e-commerce with in-house logistics, affiliate marketing, and performance marketing.
Remote / Full-time - Kyiv time zone (EET / EEST)
Mission of the Role
To turn partner traffic into a recognizable brand and loyal customers that deliver sustainable growth in LTV and revenue.
Requirements

• 4-6 years in marketing, including 2+ years in a leadership role.

• Experience in D2C / e-commerce / Health & Beauty / FMCG with a solid understanding of direct online sales.

• Proven product marketing experience: positioning, GTM, and launching offers from scratch with measurable results.

• Experience working with offers, pricing, funnels, and their unit economics (COD or marketplaces a plus).

• Experience building and managing product subscriptions / a continuity model.

• Experience building and scaling partner (affiliate) traffic.

• English at Upper-Intermediate (B2+) level, preferably C1.

• Ukrainian at C1 level or above.

Knowledge

• Product marketing core: Ideal Customer Profile, positioning, messaging, competitive analysis, product-market fit.

• Building a straight-sale business model: offer ladder, pricing, funnels, unit economics.

• GTM mechanics: launching into new markets, product launches, hypothesis testing.

• Retention / CRM marketing: segmentation, replenishment, LTV growth.

• Performance, affiliate, and marketplaces: the mechanics and economics of each channel.

• Metrics: acquisition (CAC, CR), value (LTV, AOV, ROMI), cohort analysis, COD economics (delivery rate).

• Advertising regulations in the Health & Beauty niche, and GDPR / local regulations across LATAM and the EU.

Skills

• Thinking in terms of unit economics and making data-driven decisions.

• A/B testing offers and creatives, and scaling winning hypotheses quickly.

• Strong analytics: working with reporting and raw data, and structuring it fast.

• Managing by objectives: OKRs / KPIs, building metrics and performance controls.

• Building relationships and communicating with international partners.

Key Responsibilities

• Designing and launching a new straight-sale business model across LATAM, Europe, and the USA.

• Driving traffic (affiliate, performance, marketplaces) for both the current and the new model.

• Owning pricing, funnels, and positioning.

• Running GTM and launching new products / offers across the EU, LATAM, and the USA.

• Growing retention / CRM marketing to increase LTV.

• Managing the budget, analytics, and reporting for the CEO.

• Managing the brand and product line for cross-sell, promos, and offer-focused creatives.

Compensation Package

• Flexible schedule: the option to start your workday between 8:00 and 11:00.

• Paid vacation (20 working days per year) and sick leave, plus additional days off on public holidays.

• Additional paid days off for your birthday, the birth of a child, marriage, or the loss of a close relative.

• Fully covered business travel (transport, accommodation, per diem).

• Investment in professional development - training, certifications, and access to courses and professional resources.

• A "Cafeteria"-style benefits system to cover individual needs within a set budget: sports, medical services, professional literature, coworking, equipment repair, and more.

Recruitment Process

• Pre-screening for fit between experience and requirements.

• Recruiter interview.

• Technical interview.

• Interview with the Hiring Manager.

• Reference check.

title: Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting (Any city, IL
description:
It takes great medical minds to create powerful solutions that solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges. Join us and put your expertise to work in ways you never imagined possible. We know you’ve honed your career in a fast-moving medical environment. While Gainwell operates with a sense of urgency, you’ll have the opportunity to work more flexible hours. And working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work-life balance, continuous learning, and career development.

Summary

As a Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting at Gainwell, you will contribute your pharmacy, Medicaid, analytical, and clinical expertise to support state Medicaid pharmacy programs and the populations they serve. This role supports the development and maintenance of Medicaid Preferred Drug Lists (PDLs), clinical coverage criteria, drug cost analyses, and supplemental rebate strategies.

The ideal candidate will be a pharmacist with extensive knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy operations, including drug pricing methodologies, supplemental rebate programs, Medicaid Drug Rebate Program concepts, clinical criteria development, and pharmacy point-of-sale (POS) claims processing. This position requires a strong ability to translate complex clinical, utilization, pricing, and rebate data into actionable recommendations for Medicaid clients.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to independently analyze large and complex pharmacy datasets are essential to success in this role.

Your role in our mission

• Support Medicaid Preferred Drug List (PDL) strategy through analysis of drug products, clinical criteria, utilization, pricing, and rebate opportunities.

• Conduct financial analyses using drug pricing, utilization, and Medicaid rebate data to support formulary and coverage recommendations.

• Evaluate clinical criteria, prior authorizations, and pharmacy benefit requirements to optimize access, cost, and rebate outcomes.

• Analyze utilization, expenditures, pricing trends, and supplemental rebate offers to develop client recommendations.

• Build reports, forecasts, and analytical models using advanced Excel and large datasets.

• Present findings to clients and committees, translating complex clinical and financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement PDL, rebate, and pharmacy program strategies.

• Monitor market developments, validate program data, and maintain accurate analytical documentation.

What we're looking for

• Licensed Pharmacist (RPh or PharmD) in the U.S.

• 5+ years of pharmacy experience, including Medicaid pharmacy, managed care, PBM operations, formulary management, or related areas.

• Strong knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy programs, including PDLs, utilization management, prior authorization, claims adjudication, and pharmacy benefit operations.

• Experience with drug pricing, Medicaid rebates, supplemental rebates, pharmaceutical contracting, and financial analysis.

• Experience developing or evaluating formularies, PDLs, prior authorization, and utilization management criteria.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including analysis of large datasets and financial modeling.

• Ability to translate clinical, pricing, utilization, and rebate data into sound pharmacy benefit recommendations.

• Preferred: Experience supporting state Medicaid PDL programs, Medicaid supplemental rebate programs, rebate pools, or multi-state contracting initiatives.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience identifying and reconciling data discrepancies across multiple sources.

What you should expect in this role

• 100% Remote (U.S. only)

• Travel: Up to 10%

Applications will be accepted through November 13, 2026.

The pay range for this position is $113,700.00 - $162,400.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region,

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway
description:

THE MISSION

The AI Gateway team is at the forefront of Kong's evolution into the Agentic Era, building the critical infrastructure that connects enterprises to the world of generative AI. We are architecting a highly performant, secure, and observable gateway that provides developers with an unparalleled 'Developer Delight' experience for AI workloads. - Architect robust solutions for integrating with various Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI platforms, shaping the future of API management for AI.

- Extensive experience in backend development, preferably with Golang and/or Python.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design principles.

- Familiarity with API gateways, service mesh, or related infrastructure technologies.

- Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency).

- Ownership: You are a self-starter who takes initiative and sees features through from conception to production.

- Urgency: You thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing quality with the need to deliver value to customers quickly.

- Collaboration: You excel at working with a globally distributed team, communicating clearly and effectively to achieve shared goals.

- Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, LLMs, or frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.

- Experience with performance tuning and optimization of high-throughput systems.

title: Tax Director, Tax Counsel
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Tax and Trade team sits at the center of OpenAI’s global growth, shaping how cutting-edge AI products, partnerships, and infrastructure scale across borders while navigating complex tax, trade, and regulatory regimes. We operate as strategic operators, not just compliance experts, embedding early in product, finance, policy, and infrastructure decisions to manage risk, unlock incentives, and enable OpenAI to grow responsibly and competitively worldwide.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Tax Director to advise on OpenAI’s global tax strategy and support the company’s continued international expansion. This role will partner closely with Legal, Finance, Corporate Development, and commercial teams on cross-border tax planning, operating model design, market entry, strategic partnerships, product launches, intercompany arrangements, and complex commercial transactions.

You will bring deep international tax expertise and practical business judgment to help OpenAI move quickly while managing risk across a rapidly evolving global footprint. The role requires someone who can translate complex tax rules into clear recommendations, build scalable frameworks, and operate as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across the company.

You’ll be responsible for:

- Support tax aspects of strategic transactions, including acquisitions, joint ventures, reorganizations, divestitures, and post-close integration, in partnership with Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance.

- Advise on international tax planning and global operating model design, including legal entity footprint, intercompany arrangements, IP ownership and use, customer contracting models, and cross-border service flows.

- Serve as a core tax business partner for global expansion initiatives, including new market entry, changes in operating footprint, and regional business scaling.

- Advise Product, Legal, Finance, and commercial teams on tax considerations for go-to-market motions, strategic partnerships, customer contracting, and new revenue models.

- Evaluate permanent establishment, withholding tax, treaty, source and character, transfer pricing, and other international tax considerations arising from global business activity.

- Monitor US and international tax law and policy developments, including Pillar Two and other global tax reform initiatives, and assess implications for OpenAI’s business planning and operating model.

- Advise on tax aspects of financing and treasury initiatives, including intercompany funding, capital structure planning, and third-party financings.

- Manage external advisors and coordinate internal stakeholders to deliver timely, practical, and high-quality tax advice across business initiatives.

- Build scalable frameworks, playbooks, and processes that enable consistent, repeatable tax advisory for a fast-growing global business.

- Communicate complex tax issues clearly to non-tax stakeholders, including senior leadership, and help drive decisions that balance tax efficiency, risk management, operational feasibility, and business priorities.

We’re looking for someone with:

- A J.D. and strong academic credentials; LL.M. in Taxation a plus.

- 12+ years of progressive international tax experience, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house experience at a high-growth multinational business.

- Strong foundation in complex domestic and cross-border M&A, joint ventures, reorganizations, and post-acquisition integrations.

- Extensive experience advising on cross-border commercial arrangements, market entry, strategic partnerships, and international expansion.

- Deep technical expertise in US international tax, including GILTI, FDII, BEAT, foreign tax credits, withholding tax, tax treaties, source and character of income, Subpart F, and permanent establishment principles.

- Strong understanding of transfer pricing principles, intercompany arrangements, IP planning, and global operating model design.

title: Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) Analyst
description:
Peraton Overview
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.
Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) Analyst to support our Corporate Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC). In this role, you will conduct large-scale cyber data analytics, lead the use of detection technologies, perform advanced threat hunting, and provide technical review of team member work. The ideal candidate is decisive, deadline‑oriented, and produces high‑quality analytic output. The DFIR Analyst works closely with the CSOC Manager to deliver detailed security event analysis, support business units, and foster collaboration across IT teams.
Key Responsibilities

• Protect the organization's IT assets as a member of the Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC).

• Implement DFIR strategies to identify risks and reduce gaps in host and network security controls.

• Collaborate with IT Operations and end users to proactively prevent intrusions and support incident response efforts.

• Prepare CSOC reports documenting security incidents from discovery through remediation.

• Support vulnerability and cyber risk management by continuously monitoring threats and exposures.

• Test and evaluate technology solutions in preparation for both small and large-scale deployments.

• Participate in periodic on-call rotations supporting 24/7 cybersecurity operations.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree or 4 additional years of experience in a cybersecurity-related field in lieu of degree, or equivalent Security Operations work experience.

• Experience with Splunk Enterprise Security or Splunk Certified Power User. Advanced Splunk certification is a plus.

• DFIR experience using Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) technologies.

• Experience performing forensic analysis on various evidence types including disk, memory, network, and cloud artifacts.

• Proficient with common scripting and programming languages.

• Experience with Risk Management Frameworks.

• In-depth understanding of common security controls for Windows, Linux, and network equipment.

• Strong attention to detail, time‑management skills, and a professional demeanor.

• US Citizenship.

Target Salary Range
$80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. title: Construction Project Risk Consultant (Full-Time)
description:
Overview
Do you have experience in project risk management and risk analysis for design and construction projects and enjoy collaborating with construction managers, contractors, owners, and designers?
MBP is looking for a project risk consultant to support qualitative and quantitative risk management tasks across market sectors including federal government, state/local government, education, healthcare, and transit. If you have experience in this area and are ready to contribute to project success, we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities

Lead and support project risk management assignments from inception through final completion. Responsibilities include:

• Lead or support project risk management assignments, in alignment with the full risk management lifecycle.

• Support development of a risk management plan.

• Coordinate with the project teams and stakeholders to facilitate the identification of risks and develop risk reports and registers, and associated risk response actions.

• Facilitate risk interviews, risk workshops, and regular risk meetings.

• Develop and utilize a Probability and Impact Matrix to rate each risk on its probability of occurrence and impact on an objective if it does occur.

• Perform quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis.

• Assist with the prioritization of risks for further analysis.

• Identify, analyze, track, record and provide guidance with respect to actions to manage and/or mitigate risks.

• Assist construction and project managers to control the risk process by continuously monitoring efforts for new, changing, and outdated risks.

Qualifications
Who We Are Looking For
Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in qualitative risk management

• Developing project risk management plans

• Facilitating project risk interviews, workshops, and update meetings

• Formulating risk mitigation strategies

• Maintaining project risk register

• Demonstrated familiarity with quantitative risk analysis

Education/Knowledge:

• Bachelor’s degree in industry-related field, advanced degree preferred

• Detailed knowledge of construction, principles of construction management and project controls

• Recent experience/technical competence in risk identification, analysis and management for projects and programs of similar scope.

• Knowledge of scheduling, cost estimating, documentation, contract administration, and construction techniques.

Preferred Certifications:

• AACE Project Risk Management Professional (PRMP)

• PMI Project Risk Management Professional (PMI-RMP)

• Certified Construction Manager (CCM)

• Professional Engineer (PE)

Skills and Abilities:

• Develop strong relationships with project stakeholders

• Exhibit interpersonal and communication skills

• Lead a team to complete tasks

• Strong verbal, written and presentation skills

• Ability to apply analytical methods and techniques as they relate to risks

• Initiate, organize and facilitate risk interviews and workshops with diverse subject matter experts

title: Prelitigation Paralegal
description:
Rutter Mills LLP, a leading personal injury law firm in Hampton Roads, is seeking an experienced and client-focused Pre-Litigation Paralegal to join our team. This role supports attorneys and clients throughout the personal injury claim process before a case enters litigation.

Schedule : Full-time Monday through Friday

Location: Remote

About the Role:

As a Pre-Litigation Paralegal, you will manage personal injury pre-litigation files through the demand stage while serving as a steady point of contact for clients. This position requires strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, and attorneys in a professional and compassionate manner.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage personal injury pre-litigation files through the demand stage

• Maintain regular communication with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, and attorneys

• Order, review, and track medical records, bills, lost wages, and other case documentation

• Prepare demand packages, correspondence, statements, and case summaries

• Maintain organized case files and deadlines in the firm’s case management system

• Assist attorneys with all aspects of pre-litigation case management

Qualifications

• 1-3+ years of Virginia personal injury pre-litigation experience preferred

• Understanding of auto insurance coverages, medical records, insurance claims, and personal injury workflow

• Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail

• Ability to manage a fast-paced caseload

title: Privacy, Risk, and AI Consultant
description:

We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. title: Senior Architect, Enterprise Agentic Automation
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production - safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, https://www.gpbullhound.com/articles/top-100-next-unicorns-the-uk-france-and-germany-lead-with-the-most-promising-technology-companies-in-europe/ 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ https://page.camunda.com/wp-2025-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-boat for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies https://flexa.careers/companies/camunda, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

We run Camunda on Camunda. Our Enterprise Agentic Automation Team (EAAT) builds production-grade agentic orchestration using Camunda's platform for Camunda's own operations, from Finance to Support to Go-to-Market. As Senior Architect, you own delivery on our EAAT-led initiatives end to end. You partner with process owners to uncover where the biggest value lies, redesign how the work should flow, decide where agents, rules or people handle each step, and shape it into scope our engineers can build from directly. Then you lead technical delivery management with our engineers, steering increments, dependencies and decisions until you get it live and prove the value. You won't design and hand over: you stay until it works in production, and keep evolving it.

What You Will Do:

- Own delivery of our use cases end to end, business and technical, from discovery to production and value realization

- Run discovery with process owners: as-is baseline, target process, and where agents, rules or humans handle each step

- Turn target processes into epics engineers can build from directly: scenarios, acceptance criteria, increments

- Design solutions within our reference architecture, and bring new patterns based on lessons learned

- Lead technical delivery on your initiatives: plan increments with the engineers, manage dependencies and risks, and keep process owners and sponsors aligned on progress and decisions

- Define and track value per initiative and increment, and keep business decisions moving

- Feed delivery learnings back into the reference architecture, our delivery method and Camunda's product

What you bring:

Ability and/or willingness to use our product https://accounts.cloud.camunda.io/signup?_ga=2.47330343.127558761.1654184528-504024057.1654184528.

Must Haves:

- 7+ years in solution architecture or technical/process consulting, with an engineering background (Java, JavaScript or similar) and significant time delivering for the business or customers

- A track record of leading process orchestration initiatives (Camunda or comparable) from discovery to production, not just designing them and handing over

- Strong business analysis and process management skills: runs discovery and process redesign workshops with business stakeholders, models processes in BPMN, and turns the outcome into solid solution designs

- Solution and data architecture in an enterprise context: integrations and APIs, and the data a process and its agents need across systems

- An AI-first mindset

title: Senior ICE Specialist
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott , you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

• Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.

• An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution.

• Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

• A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

In Abbott ’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

As an Abbott ICE Specialist, you will focus on providing exceptional technical and clinical support for Abbott 's intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) technology. You’ll support physicians and healthcare professionals during procedures using Abbott ICE, educating them on proper product usage, and providing troubleshooting assistance. The ICE specialist will also gather customer feedback, ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines, and contributing to the improvement of Abbott 's ICE product portfolio

• Provide expert support during Cardiac ablation and Structural Heart procedures, including case planning, preparation, and troubleshooting.

• Maintain deep clinical knowledge of cardiac anatomy, electrophysiology, and Intracardiac Echo technology, as well as other imaging modalities like TEE and TTE.

• Educate physicians, healthcare professionals, and Abbott team members on the efficacy and use of Abbott ICE products.

• Resolve technical issues and providing guidance on product usage through various communication channels.

• Gather and relaying customer feedback to internal teams for product improvement and development.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory, quality, and safety guidelines.

• Collaborate with sales, upstream/downstream marketing, and R&D teams to support business objectives and product advancements and collaborate closely with Electrophysiologists, interventional cardiologists, and lab staff to ensure optimal image acquisition and interpretation

Required Qualifications

• An associate's degree or higher in nursing, sonography, cardiovascular technology, or a related clinical field, or equivalent clinical experience.

• Minimum of 6 years of experience in cardiovascular, electrophysiology, or structural heart procedures, including experience with ICE, TEE, TTE, and vascular ultrasound.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• A Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) or Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS) certification

title: Meeting Manager
description:
RESUME AND COVER LETTER REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION

Deadline to apply is November 19, 2026

Salary: $75,000-$87,000 annually. Salary is dependent on experience and qualifications.

SUMMARY

The Meeting Manager assumes full responsibility for the planning, management, production, and execution of face to face events (ranging in size of 10-800 people) or online events, including the Online Annual Conference. Responsibilities generally include complex project management, detailed planning, contingency planning, troubleshooting, executing and evaluating association conferences from inception to completion. This position develops and manages all related budgets associated with the meeting planning process and leads the ops teams. The Meeting Manager works with other staff, member volunteers, program committees and presenters; liaises with hotel suppliers, related vendors, and builds a positive and professional image for all EDUCAUSE events.

In addition, this position plays a critical role navigating the complexities of online conferences. This includes managing digital integrations, fostering engagement within virtual communities, and delivering value to members through seamless online experiences. This position is instrumental in enhancing member engagement and facilitating impactful learning experiences.

In this role, the Meeting Manager must be a creative problem-solver, an excellent communicator with exceptional project management abilities, confident in decision-making, and able to remain composed under pressure.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Management and Event Architecture

• Works with the event stakeholders to ensure the event strategy will meet event objectives and align with organizational objectives, when applicable.

• Designs and builds the event components in conjunction with stakeholders and vendors, but has the acumen to know when decisions can be made unilaterally.

• Responsible for the full scope of event project management, creating a detailed timeline, and adhering to strict deadlines to ensure successful execution of event logistics.

• Oversees and manages all aspects of meeting logistics, including but not limited to registration, food and beverage, audio/visual, exhibits/corporate displays, floorplans, website/marketing review, internet requirements and connectivity, security, rigging, electrical, and on-site operations. Develop detailed logistical meeting specifications and effectively communicate those plans to all vendors and facilities to ensure a successful conference or event.

• Updates meeting information in EDUCAUSE database (netFORUM) ensuring information is accurate.

• Oversees the entire event on-site or online and serves as liaison for the association and participants during the event to address and resolve concerns or issues.

• Advise on external online learning trends and effective practices that support continuous improvement, event attendance growth, participant engagement, participant satisfaction, and cost effectiveness.

• Analyze post-event data, including attendee and exhibitor feedback, satisfaction and net promoter scores, and other metrics or indicators to identify trends and insights to provide actionable recommendations for improving the planning, execution, and outcomes of future events.

• Working with the Sr. Director of Conferences and the Sr. Meeting Manager, manages assigned functions for the in-person Annual Conference, in addition to the Online Annual Conference.

Conference OpsTeam Management

• Leads and manages conference ops team composed of internal stakeholders and those responsible for a segment or function of the planning and execution of the event.

• Facilitates regular scheduled monthly or bi-weekly meetings

• Develops timelines and establishes metrics to ensure deadlines are met for all event tasks.

• Consults with team members to troubleshoot challenges; recommends, provides, and implements logistical solutions
